title: can not find this notification output in filer replication
body:
Sponsors SeaweedFS via Patreon https://www.patreon.com/seaweedfs

**Describe the bug**
In [this](https://github.com/chrislusf/seaweedfs/wiki/Async-Replication-to-another-Filer) document when I execute `weed scaffold -config=filer`  it has this output :

    masood@office:~/Downloads➜  ./weed scaffold -config=filer

- Debian 10
- x86_64 Linux 4.19.0-9-amd64

where can I find `[notification]` for config `RabbitMQ` to sync filer together?   
Is this possible to sync through `RabbitMQ`? and how if it is possible?

My `weed` version is :

    version 30GB 1.82 c48b407 linux amd64
